name: Annex Liquidator unvalidated flash-swap callback
summary: The Annex Liquidator's PancakeSwap flash-swap callback never verified that msg.sender was a legitimate factory pair, so the attacker created a pair for a worthless self-minted token and had it call the liquidator, draining its WBNB.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
